title: ERP · Unified clinical workspace
brief: One runnable Spanish-language staff ERP demo for fictional Clínica Dental Andina. The same responsive shell connects editable resources and patient antecedents to appointment creation, clinical documentation, laboratory/imaging requests and human results, one issued order, simulated cash/non-payable QR confirmations and DEMO receipts. Stable-ID in-memory records with integer-cent billing and immutable issued lines; reload resets everything. S1-S7 prototype flows covered, never real clinical/payment/backend readiness. Offline public-UI smoke: PASS 304 checks; zero HTTP/API/storage writes or page errors.

artboards.title: Unified business workspace
artboards.tradeoff: Connected catalog-to-consultation-to-receipt workflow in one offline artboard; explicit simulation, no real medicine, payment provider or durable storage
